label: ZXA10 C300 OLT
description: ZTE ZXA10 C300 carrier OLT, 10U vertical-slot chassis: 14 service slots in the 19-inch (21-slot) shelf, 16 in the 21-inch (23-slot) shelf, 2 control/switch slots (SCXN 480G or SCTM 2.56T) and 2 uplink-card slots, up to 16384 GPON users. This spec models one GTGH 16-port GPON card (gpon2/1-16) + one XUTQ 4x 10GE SFP+ uplink card + 1 out-of-band management port = 21 ports.
